deep_analysis.text: Cross-asset signals are pulling in different directions today. Gold's modest gain alongside a firmer VIX and softer BTC suggests some hedging demand, yet DXY sits flat and equities are only mildly softer, undercutting a clean risk-off narrative. Copper and WTI both firming point to underlying growth resilience, while yields ticked up slightly, offering the dollar little support. Headlines center on broad dollar softness, particularly against the yen amid BOJ rate-hike speculation, with EUR/USD and GBP/USD recovering ahead of Friday's payrolls. Overall backdr
